findings.where: svg.chart x5 (NRR bars, plan donut, 3 region sparklines)
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json records no name, role or title on any svg.chart; the weekly bar values and region trends exist only as drawing, with no table or text equivalent (the sparklines' percentages are given, the bars' values are not).
findings.after: role="img" aria-label="Net recurring revenue by week, weeks 21-27: ..." on each chart, or a visually hidden <table> of the weekly values

findings.evidence: Verified sweep hit: focus/08-on.png shows only the selected tab's soft 0 1px 2px shadow, identical to its resting state; no ring.
findings.after: [role=tab]:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f3f5f7, 0 0 0 4px #006a6a } (the ring used on nav links)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.

findings.where: bar chart (hero), plan donut, region sparklines
findings.evidence: T-GRAYSCALE: the partial week is distinguished only by orange vs blue; donut segments by hue only (legend dots); region lines by hue only (blue, orange, violet). Status badges do carry text ('Healthy', 'At risk', 'Churning'), which passes.
findings.after: Add a pattern or outline to the partial bar plus a direct label 'Wk 27 (partial)'; label donut segments in place
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast.

findings.where: focus stop 9: section.hero card 'NET RECURRING REVENUE'
findings.evidence: focus.json stop 9 is a <section> with tabindex showing only a 1px auto outline (focus/09-on.png): a non-interactive card is a tab stop with no name or purpose announced.
findings.after: Remove tabindex, or give it role="region" aria-label="Net recurring revenue" and the same 2px teal ring as other controls
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.3 Focus Order and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.

findings.evidence: focus.json stop 15 records an empty text for this link and 1px default outline; nav links use a 2px teal ring, footer links fall back to the browser default.
findings.after: Apply the shared :focus-visible ring to footer links

strengths: Skip-to-main is the first focusable element; nav links, search, theme and notifications buttons show a 2px teal ring with offset.
Icon buttons have names ('Switch to dark theme', 'Notifications, 3 unread'); tabs use role=tab; table sort controls are real buttons.
not_investigated: aria-selected / aria-sort state on tabs and sortable headers: not in the dom capture.
Reflow at 320px and the horizontally scrolling nav at 375 (tile shows 'Accounts' cut at the edge): not checked live.
